project_type: Cloudflare Workers backend (mgmt/backend, ESM .mjs/.js) + SvelteKit public/admin frontend (mgmt/frontend-svelte) + legacy React frontend; multi-D1-database data model. This is the Chhath Puja committee management portal.
build_system: npm per package. Backend has no build step (plain ESM run under Node/Workers). frontend-svelte uses Vite/SvelteKit (npm run build).
test_framework: node:test (built-in) with node --test. Tests in mgmt/backend/test/*.test.mjs use in-memory node:sqlite (DatabaseSync) seeded from the REAL committed schema via helpers/stubs.mjs schemaFor(). No external test deps.
build_command: Backend: none. Frontend consent page: cd mgmt/frontend-svelte && npm install && npm run build
test_command: PATH must prepend /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin. Backend: cd mgmt/backend && node --test --test-reporter=spec test/*.test.mjs (baseline 1097 pass / 0 fail).
verification_instructions: 1) export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH". 2) cd mgmt/backend && node --test --test-reporter=spec test/*.test.mjs — all must pass incl. migration-matrix, migration-target-databases, pr35-migration-ledger, h10-m38. 3) If frontend-svelte touched: cd mgmt/frontend-svelte && npm install && npm run build must succeed.
setup_instructions: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH"; cd mgmt/backend && npm install (already installed, node_modules present). Node v22.23.2, npx wrangler 4.135.0 available.
environment_constraints: Migrations are guarded by tests that run the SQL in-memory against the committed schema (node:sqlite). D1 rejects explicit BEGIN/COMMIT/SAVEPOINT in --file scripts, so the migration SQL must contain NO explicit transaction statements. A live D1 database is NOT reachable from the sandbox; the migrate.mjs runner shells out to wrangler and is not exercised here — only the pure guard tests run.
contribution_requirements: New migrations must: (a) live in a dated folder under mgmt/db/migration/; (b) name a REAL db from wrangler.toml in the header as 'wrangler d1 execute chhath-templates'; (c) be single-database + have executable SQL (kind 'runnable') so pr35-migration-ledger count assertions (multi-db===2, inert===6) stay intact; (d) be idempotent (applied twice with no error against the committed schema); (e) be registered in migration-matrix.test.mjs DECLARED with { schema: 'templates.sql' } (use a NEW folder 2026-09-18, NOT 2026-09-05 which is delegated to h10).
key_patterns: Idempotent seed via DELETE-by-type then INSERT (no UNIQUE index on consent_page_templates.type, so ON CONFLICT is unavailable). Placeholder map is single source of truth in consentPlaceholders.js: buildConsentPlaceholders() (per-target) and consentPlaceholderFactory() (loan-level base + per-consent closure) MUST stay in sync. Reuse statusLabel(status,row) for *_STATUS tokens. The public consent Svelte page substitutes only [A-Z0-9_]+ bracket tokens; unknown tokens render as literal text.
relevant_files: mgmt/backend/src/consentPlaceholders.js (ADD 4 tokens: LOAN_CONSENT_DATETIME, LOAN_STATUS, CONSENT_DATETIME, CONSENT_STATUS)
mgmt/backend/src/loans.js (getConsentByToken ~706 — confirms loaner_consent/guarantor_consent are the preview keys; no change expected)
mgmt/db/schema/loans_expenses.sql (loan_consents columns: created_at, responded_at, status, verification_status/remarks, decline_remarks)
mgmt/backend/test/h11-m14-batched-lookups.test.mjs (pattern for consent placeholder tests: baseEnv, seedMembers, loan_consents seed, DB_TEMPLATES seed)
mgmt/frontend-svelte/src/routes/consent/[token]/+page.svelte (public preview page; substitutePlaceholders + existing accept/tick/decline UI — verify, no second UI)
directory_structure: mgmt/backend/src = Worker source (loans.js, settings.js, consentPlaceholders.js). mgmt/backend/test = node:test suites. mgmt/db/schema = committed DDL per D1 db. mgmt/db/migration/<date>/NN-*.sql = migrations (ledger-tracked). mgmt/frontend-svelte = SvelteKit app hosting the public /consent/[token] page.
